test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The average age of 17 persons is 37 years. The average age increases by 1 year when 2 new persons are included. What is the average age of the new persons?
solution:
**Given**

The average age of 17 persons is 37 years.

The average age increases by 1 year when 2 new persons are included.

**Formula used:**

Average = Sum of all values / Total values

Calculation:

Total age of 17 persons = 17 × 37

= 629

After adding 2 more persons the new average will be = 37 + 1

= 38

Now the total age of 19 persons = 19 × 38

= 722

Age of two new persons = 722 – 629 = 93

The average age of the new persons = 93 / 2

⇒ 46 (1/2)

**The average age of the new persons is 46 (1/2)**
